# POIMediaGallery

POI media sequence with explicit position, 44px controls and alternative text. An empty array renders nothing. A failed image displays a localized failure label; changing its source retries it. This story uses synthetic labelled tiles, not venue photographs.

- **Import:** `import { POIMediaGallery } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Product SDK
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/product-sdk-poimediagallery--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { POIMediaGallery, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

const image = (label: string, color: string) =>
  `data:image/svg+xml,${encodeURIComponent(
    `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="640" height="480" viewBox="0 0 640 480"><rect width="640" height="480" fill="${color}"/><text x="320" y="240" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="middle" font-family="system-ui" font-size="28" fill="#17191c">${label}</text></svg>`,
  )}`;

export function POIMediaGalleryExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <POIMediaGallery
        className="w-full max-w-[26rem]"
        label="Place photos"
        media={[
          {
            id: "entrance",
            src: image("Entrance", "#dff3ef"),
            alt: "Main entrance",
          },
          {
            id: "counter",
            src: image("Counter", "#f4e6ff"),
            alt: "Service counter",
          },
        ]}
        onActiveIndexChange={() => {}}
        positionLabel={(current, total) => `Image ${current} of ${total}`}
      />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## POIMediaGallery

It forwards its ref to `HTMLElement`. Its props are `POIMediaGalleryProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, "onChange">`.

- `media`: `readonly POIMediaPresentation[]`, **required**.
- `label`: `string`, **required**.
- `activeIndex`: `number`, optional.
- `defaultActiveIndex`: `number`, optional, default `0`.
- `onActiveIndexChange`: `(index: number) => void`, optional.
- `previousLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Previous image"`.
- `nextLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Next image"`.
- `controlsLabel`: `string`, optional, default `` `${label} controls` ``.
- `unavailableLabel`: `string`, optional, default `"Image unavailable"`.
- `positionLabel`: `(current: number, total: number) => string`, **required**.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the 262 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).

## Types these props take

### POIMediaPresentation

From `@kozmos-ds/product-contracts`.

```ts
interface POIMediaPresentation {
  id: string;
  src: string;
  alt: string;
}
```
